subject.title: Silent empty tool results in long-running Sonnet 5 sessions after a large tool result

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 be treated as the canonical fix path for this cross-provider empty tool-result report, or should this issue require separate provider-bound payload proof before it is considered covered?
rationale: The source path and related reports strongly overlap with the open prompt-projection fix, but the exact long-session provider payload failure has not been replayed on the candidate branch.

options.title: Use the prompt-projection candidate
options.body: Treat the issue as part of the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 cluster, keep it open until that PR lands, and then verify with redacted long-session payload evidence.

options.title: Require separate live proof
options.body: Keep this issue as its own tracker until a sanitized Anthropic or Google provider-bound payload comparison proves the candidate fix covers this exact symptom.

recommendation.title: Use the prompt-projection candidate
recommendation.body: Treat the issue as part of the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 cluster, keep it open until that PR lands, and then verify with redacted long-session payload evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently gave maintainer direction on the adjacent projection-alignment PR and are the clearest observed human reviewer for the session-state tradeoff.
